meta.source: SAP Theming Base Content (@sap-theming/theming-base-content), themes sap_horizon and sap_horizon_dark; SAP Fiori Design Guidelines for Web

tokens.name: sapBrandColor
tokens.usage: SAP brand blue. Fill of emphasized buttons and brand accents. Not a text color on light surfaces; use sapLinkColor or sapButton_TextColor instead.

tokens.name: sapHighlightColor
tokens.usage: Selected and highlighted state: selected tab text and underline, selected list item markers, the checked tick of a CheckBox.

tokens.name: sapBaseColor
tokens.usage: Base surface of controls and containers: cards, lists, tables, bars, dialogs.

tokens.name: sapShellColor
tokens.usage: Background of the ShellBar (top application header).

tokens.name: sapBackgroundColor
tokens.usage: Application/page background behind cards, tables and object page sections.

tokens.name: sapTextColor
tokens.usage: Default text on sapBaseColor and sapBackgroundColor (16.9:1 / 14.6:1).

tokens.name: sapTitleColor
tokens.usage: Titles and headers on sapBaseColor and sapBackgroundColor.

tokens.name: sapLinkColor
tokens.usage: Links on sapBaseColor and sapBackgroundColor (5.5:1 / 4.8:1). Underline on hover.

tokens.name: sapContent_LabelColor
tokens.usage: Field labels, secondary text, subtitles and table header-less attribute labels, on sapBaseColor and sapBackgroundColor (5.1:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: sapContent_DisabledTextColor
tokens.usage: Text of disabled elements where the whole control is not dimmed with sapContent_DisabledOpacity.

tokens.name: sapContent_IconColor
tokens.usage: Interactive icons that are not inside a button (e.g. a clickable icon in a list).

tokens.name: sapContent_NonInteractiveIconColor
tokens.usage: Decorative, non-interactive icons such as the navigation chevron at the end of a table row (3.5:1 on white, meets the 3:1 icon floor).

tokens.name: sapContent_ForegroundBorderColor
tokens.usage: Borders of content-level elements that need a visible outline, e.g. an unchecked RadioButton ring.

tokens.name: sapContent_FocusColor
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: .125rem solid, on every interactive element (10.5:1 on white, 9.9:1 on dark base).

tokens.name: sapContent_ContrastTextColor
tokens.usage: Text on strong fills such as sapBrandColor or indication color backgrounds.

tokens.name: sapContent_ImagePlaceholderBackground
tokens.usage: Background of an empty image or avatar placeholder.

tokens.name: sapNegativeColor
tokens.usage: Negative (error) semantic color for values and icons.

tokens.name: sapCriticalColor
tokens.usage: Critical (warning) semantic color for icons and large marks. For text use sapCriticalTextColor.

tokens.name: sapPositiveColor
tokens.usage: Positive (success) semantic color for values and icons.

tokens.name: sapInformativeColor
tokens.usage: Informative semantic color for icons and marks.

tokens.name: sapNeutralColor
tokens.usage: Neutral semantic color for icons and marks (3.3:1 on white: icons and marks only, not small text).

tokens.name: sapNegativeElementColor
tokens.usage: Error icons in MessageStrip, field value-state icons, chart elements.

tokens.name: sapCriticalElementColor
tokens.usage: Warning icons in MessageStrip, field value-state icons, chart elements.

tokens.name: sapPositiveElementColor
tokens.usage: Success icons in MessageStrip, chart elements.

tokens.name: sapInformativeElementColor
tokens.usage: Information icons in MessageStrip, chart elements.

tokens.name: sapNeutralElementColor
tokens.usage: Neutral icons and chart elements.

tokens.name: sapNegativeTextColor
tokens.usage: Error text (ObjectStatus Error, Tag) on sapBaseColor and sapErrorBackground (6.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: sapCriticalTextColor
tokens.usage: Warning text (ObjectStatus Warning, Tag) on sapBaseColor and sapWarningBackground (4.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: sapPositiveTextColor
tokens.usage: Success text (ObjectStatus Success, Tag) on sapBaseColor and sapSuccessBackground (5.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: sapInformativeTextColor
tokens.usage: Information text (ObjectStatus Information, Tag) on sapBaseColor and sapInformationBackground (4.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: sapErrorBackground
tokens.usage: Background of error MessageStrip, error Tag, and invalid field.

tokens.name: sapWarningBackground
tokens.usage: Background of warning MessageStrip, warning Tag, and field in warning state.

tokens.name: sapSuccessBackground
tokens.usage: Background of success MessageStrip and success Tag.

tokens.name: sapInformationBackground
tokens.usage: Background of information MessageStrip, information Tag and field in information state.

tokens.name: sapNeutralBackground
tokens.usage: Background of neutral Tag and neutral MessageStrip.

tokens.name: sapErrorBorderColor
tokens.usage: Border of error MessageStrip and Tag.

tokens.name: sapWarningBorderColor
tokens.usage: Border of warning MessageStrip and Tag.

tokens.name: sapSuccessBorderColor
tokens.usage: Border of success MessageStrip and Tag.

tokens.name: sapInformationBorderColor
tokens.usage: Border of information MessageStrip and Tag.

tokens.name: sapShell_Background
tokens.usage: Launchpad/shell canvas behind the app (home page with tiles).

tokens.name: sapShell_BorderColor
tokens.usage: Separators inside shell areas.

tokens.name: sapShell_TextColor
tokens.usage: Text in the ShellBar (product title) on sapShellColor.

tokens.name: sapShell_InteractiveTextColor
tokens.usage: Icons and text of ShellBar action buttons on sapShellColor.

tokens.name: sapShell_Hover_Background
tokens.usage: Hover background of interactive shell elements on sapShell_Background.

tokens.name: sapShell_Active_Background
tokens.usage: Pressed background of interactive shell elements on sapShell_Background.

tokens.name: sapButton_Background
tokens.usage: Default button fill.

tokens.name: sapButton_BorderColor
tokens.usage: Default button border.

tokens.name: sapButton_TextColor
tokens.usage: Default button text and icon on sapButton_Background (5.5:1 / 6.8:1).

tokens.name: sapButton_Hover_Background
tokens.usage: Default button on hover.

tokens.name: sapButton_Hover_BorderColor
tokens.usage: Default button border on hover.

tokens.name: sapButton_Active_Background
tokens.usage: Any button while pressed (default, emphasized, transparent).

tokens.name: sapButton_Active_BorderColor
tokens.usage: Button border while pressed.

tokens.name: sapButton_Active_TextColor
tokens.usage: Button text while pressed.

tokens.name: sapButton_Emphasized_Background
tokens.usage: Emphasized (primary) button fill. One per area, for the main action.

tokens.name: sapButton_Emphasized_BorderColor
tokens.usage: Emphasized button border.

tokens.name: sapButton_Emphasized_TextColor
tokens.usage: Emphasized button text on sapButton_Emphasized_Background (4.6:1).

tokens.name: sapButton_Emphasized_Hover_Background
tokens.usage: Emphasized button on hover.

tokens.name: sapButton_Emphasized_Active_Background
tokens.usage: Emphasized button while pressed (inverts to outline style).

tokens.name: sapButton_Emphasized_Active_TextColor
tokens.usage: Emphasized button text while pressed.

tokens.name: sapButton_Lite_Background
tokens.usage: Transparent button fill (toolbars, ShellBar, table toolbars).

tokens.name: sapButton_Lite_TextColor
tokens.usage: Transparent button text and icon.

tokens.name: sapButton_Lite_Hover_Background
tokens.usage: Transparent button on hover.

tokens.name: sapButton_Selected_Background
tokens.usage: Toggle or segmented button in the selected state.

tokens.name: sapButton_Selected_BorderColor
tokens.usage: Border of a selected toggle button.

tokens.name: sapButton_Selected_TextColor
tokens.usage: Text of a selected toggle button (5.0:1 / 6.7:1).

tokens.name: sapButton_Accept_Background
tokens.usage: Positive (accept/approve) button fill.

tokens.name: sapButton_Accept_BorderColor
tokens.usage: Positive button border.

tokens.name: sapButton_Accept_TextColor
tokens.usage: Positive button text (5.4:1 / 7.3:1).

tokens.name: sapButton_Reject_Background
tokens.usage: Negative (reject/delete) button fill.

tokens.name: sapButton_Reject_BorderColor
tokens.usage: Negative button border.

tokens.name: sapButton_Reject_TextColor
tokens.usage: Negative button text (5.8:1 / 5.4:1).

tokens.name: sapButton_Attention_Background
tokens.usage: Attention button fill (actions that need care).

tokens.name: sapButton_Attention_TextColor
tokens.usage: Attention button text (4.6:1 / 11:1).

tokens.name: sapField_Background
tokens.usage: Input, Select, TextArea and CheckBox box fill.

tokens.name: sapField_TextColor
tokens.usage: Entered value in fields on sapField_Background.

tokens.name: sapField_PlaceholderTextColor
tokens.usage: Placeholder text in fields (5.5:1 / 5.6:1).

tokens.name: sapField_BorderColor
tokens.usage: Bottom border of fields and the CheckBox outline (5.5:1 / 8.1:1).

tokens.name: sapField_Hover_Background
tokens.usage: Field fill on hover.

tokens.name: sapField_Hover_BorderColor
tokens.usage: Field bottom border on hover.

tokens.name: sapField_Focus_BorderColor
tokens.usage: Field border while focused (paired with the focus outline).

tokens.name: sapField_InvalidColor
tokens.usage: Bottom border (.125rem) of a field in error state.

tokens.name: sapField_InvalidBackground
tokens.usage: Fill of a field in error state.

tokens.name: sapField_WarningColor
tokens.usage: Bottom border of a field in warning state.

tokens.name: sapField_SuccessColor
tokens.usage: Bottom border of a field in success state.

tokens.name: sapField_InformationColor
tokens.usage: Bottom border of a field in information state.

tokens.name: sapField_ReadOnly_Background
tokens.usage: Fill of a read-only field.

tokens.name: sapField_ReadOnly_BorderColor
tokens.usage: Border of a read-only field when one is drawn.

tokens.name: sapGroup_TitleBackground
tokens.usage: Header area of cards and form groups.

tokens.name: sapGroup_TitleTextColor
tokens.usage: Card and group titles.

tokens.name: sapGroup_ContentBackground
tokens.usage: Body of cards, form containers and object page sections.

tokens.name: sapGroup_ContentBorderColor
tokens.usage: Dividers inside cards and between form groups.

tokens.name: sapList_Background
tokens.usage: List and table rows.

tokens.name: sapList_BorderColor
tokens.usage: Row separators in lists and tables.

tokens.name: sapList_TextColor
tokens.usage: Cell and list item text.

tokens.name: sapList_HeaderBackground
tokens.usage: Table column header row and list header.

tokens.name: sapList_HeaderTextColor
tokens.usage: Table column header text.

tokens.name: sapList_HeaderBorderColor
tokens.usage: Line under the table column header row.

tokens.name: sapList_TableGroupHeaderBackground
tokens.usage: Group header row inside a table.

tokens.name: sapList_Hover_Background
tokens.usage: Row on hover (interactive rows only).

tokens.name: sapList_Active_Background
tokens.usage: Row while pressed.

tokens.name: sapList_SelectionBackgroundColor
tokens.usage: Selected row fill.

tokens.name: sapList_SelectionBorderColor
tokens.usage: Bottom line of a selected row.

tokens.name: sapList_AlternatingBackground
tokens.usage: Alternating (zebra) rows, only in grid tables.

tokens.name: sapObjectHeader_Background
tokens.usage: Dynamic page and object page header.

tokens.name: sapObjectHeader_BorderColor
tokens.usage: Line under the object page header and anchor bar.

tokens.name: sapObjectHeader_Title_TextColor
tokens.usage: Object page title.

tokens.name: sapObjectHeader_Subtitle_TextColor
tokens.usage: Object page subtitle.

tokens.name: sapTile_Background
tokens.usage: Launchpad tiles and cards' default surface.

tokens.name: sapTile_TitleTextColor
tokens.usage: Tile title.

tokens.name: sapTile_TextColor
tokens.usage: Tile subtitle and footer text.

tokens.name: sapTile_Hover_Background
tokens.usage: Interactive tile/card on hover.

tokens.name: sapToolbar_Background
tokens.usage: Toolbars (table toolbars, header toolbars).

tokens.name: sapToolbar_SeparatorColor
tokens.usage: Vertical separators between toolbar groups.

tokens.name: sapPageHeader_Background
tokens.usage: Page and dialog header bar.

tokens.name: sapPageFooter_Background
tokens.usage: Footer toolbar (floating footer with page actions) and dialog footer.

tokens.name: sapPageFooter_BorderColor
tokens.usage: Top border of footers.

tokens.name: sapBlockLayer_Background
tokens.usage: Modal overlay behind dialogs, used at 20% opacity.

tokens.name: sapScrollBar_FaceColor
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb.

tokens.name: sapProgress_Background
tokens.usage: ProgressIndicator track.

tokens.name: sapProgress_Value_Background
tokens.usage: ProgressIndicator neutral value bar.

tokens.name: sapIndicationColor_1_Background
tokens.usage: Indication color 1 (dark red): fill of inverted ObjectStatus and indication Tags; text on it is sapIndicationColor_1_TextColor.

tokens.name: sapIndicationColor_1_TextColor
tokens.usage: Text on sapIndicationColor_1_Background.

tokens.name: sapIndicationColor_2_Background
tokens.usage: Indication color 2 (red): fill of inverted ObjectStatus and indication Tags; text on it is sapIndicationColor_2_TextColor.

tokens.name: sapIndicationColor_2_TextColor
tokens.usage: Text on sapIndicationColor_2_Background.

tokens.name: sapIndicationColor_3_Background
tokens.usage: Indication color 3 (orange): fill of inverted ObjectStatus and indication Tags; text on it is sapIndicationColor_3_TextColor. Source pair misses 4.5:1 in Morning Horizon (white on #e76500 is 3.4:1): use bold text 14px+ or a non-inverted status.

tokens.name: sapIndicationColor_3_TextColor
tokens.usage: Text on sapIndicationColor_3_Background.

tokens.name: sapIndicationColor_4_Background
tokens.usage: Indication color 4 (green): fill of inverted ObjectStatus and indication Tags; text on it is sapIndicationColor_4_TextColor.

tokens.name: sapIndicationColor_4_TextColor
tokens.usage: Text on sapIndicationColor_4_Background.

tokens.name: sapIndicationColor_5_Background
tokens.usage: Indication color 5 (blue): fill of inverted ObjectStatus and indication Tags; text on it is sapIndicationColor_5_TextColor.

tokens.name: sapIndicationColor_5_TextColor
tokens.usage: Text on sapIndicationColor_5_Background.

tokens.name: sapIndicationColor_6_Background
tokens.usage: Indication color 6 (teal): fill of inverted ObjectStatus and indication Tags; text on it is sapIndicationColor_6_TextColor.

tokens.name: sapIndicationColor_6_TextColor
tokens.usage: Text on sapIndicationColor_6_Background.

tokens.name: sapIndicationColor_7_Background
tokens.usage: Indication color 7 (indigo): fill of inverted ObjectStatus and indication Tags; text on it is sapIndicationColor_7_TextColor.

tokens.name: sapIndicationColor_7_TextColor
tokens.usage: Text on sapIndicationColor_7_Background.

tokens.name: sapIndicationColor_8_Background
tokens.usage: Indication color 8 (purple): fill of inverted ObjectStatus and indication Tags; text on it is sapIndicationColor_8_TextColor.

tokens.name: sapIndicationColor_8_TextColor
tokens.usage: Text on sapIndicationColor_8_Background.

styles.name: sapFontHeader1
styles.usage: sapFontHeader1Size. Rare: hero numbers or launchpad welcome.

styles.name: sapFontHeader3
styles.usage: sapFontHeader3Size. Section titles in object pages.

styles.name: sapFontHeader4
styles.usage: sapFontHeader4Size. Dynamic page title, dialog title in large dialogs.

styles.name: sapFontHeader5
styles.usage: sapFontHeader5Size. Card titles, table titles, subsection titles.

styles.name: sapFontHeader6
styles.usage: sapFontHeader6Size. Form group titles, table column headers.

styles.name: objectTitle
styles.usage: Object page title (sapObjectHeader_Title_FontSize) in 72 Black, the Horizon key-title weight.

styles.name: sapFontLarge
styles.usage: sapFontLargeSize. KPI values in headers, emphasized text.

styles.name: sapFont
styles.usage: sapFontSize. Default for all control text, cells, labels and body copy.

styles.name: sapFontSmall
styles.usage: sapFontSmallSize. Tags, timestamps, secondary info. Never for primary content.

styles.name: sapButtonText
styles.usage: Button labels (sapButton_FontFamily is 72-SemiboldDuplex). Emphasized buttons use the bold family.

tokens.name: sapContent_Space_Tiny
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls (button to button in a toolbar, label to field).

tokens.name: sapContent_Space_Small
tokens.usage: Card padding; page content padding on phones (< 600px); gap between cards.

tokens.name: sapContent_Space_Medium
tokens.usage: Page content padding on tablets and desktops (600–1439px); gap between form columns.

tokens.name: sapContent_Space_Large
tokens.usage: Page content padding on wide screens (1440px and up).

tokens.name: sapField_BorderCornerRadius

tokens.name: sapPopover_BorderCornerRadius
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, dropdown lists, dialogs.

tokens.name: sapElement_BorderCornerRadius

tokens.name: sapTile_BorderCornerRadius

tokens.name: sapContent_Shadow0
